name: Extreme Components
old_description: Extreme Components Inc., founded in 2005 and headquartered in Neptune, New Jersey, is a specialized distributor and service provider in the electronic components industry. The company caters primarily to the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet diverse client needs.
about:
Extreme Components Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Neptune Township, New Jersey. The company operates as a specialized distributor and service provider in the electronic components industry, focusing on delivering prompt service and high-quality products to a global customer base.

As an ISO-certified broad-line stocking distributor, Extreme Components maintains an inventory of over 220,000 electronic components, including obsolete and hard-to-find parts. The company offers inventory search and procurement services, with a commitment to next-day sourcing for items not in stock. Its quality management system supports global logistics and on-time delivery from its New Jersey facility.

The distributor serves customers primarily in the aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors, supplying electronic components and related products to meet diverse application requirements. Its client base includes organizations requiring reliable access to difficult-to-source components for critical systems.

Extreme Components emphasizes service, support, and flexibility as its core differentiators, promoting a model of extreme service, extreme support, and extreme flexibility to address urgent component needs worldwide. The company's stated goal is to provide flexible support no matter where the customer is located.
